description: This file defines the FilterHtml class for Drupal, which provides a filter to restrict allowed HTML tags and attributes, including configuration forms, HTML restrictions, and filtering logic.

classes.name: FilterHtml
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that filters HTML content by restricting allowed tags and attributes, with configuration options and filtering logic.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for allowed HTML tags and filtering options.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the filter configuration and resets restrictions cache.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Filters the input HTML text based on restrictions and attribute filtering.

methods.name: filterAttributes
methods.description: Filters HTML attributes on elements according to allowed attributes and values.

methods.name: filterElementAttributes
methods.description: Filters attributes on a DOM element based on allowed attribute names and values.

methods.name: findAllowedValue
methods.description: Finds if an attribute name or value matches allowed patterns, including wildcards.

methods.name: prepareAttributeValues
methods.description: Prepares attribute value lists, handling wildcards and exact matches.

methods.name: getHTMLRestrictions
methods.description: Parses and computes the restrictions for allowed HTML tags and attributes.

methods.name: tips
methods.description: Provides help and examples for allowed HTML tags and entities.
